jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Job summary  
Love to work in Digital Advertising; one of the biggest revenue drivers for internet giants of the world and Amazon’s fastest-growing business with an explosive growth?  
  
Love to conceptualise and build applications from grounds-up? Like to develop real-time, distributed and large-scale applications? Like to interact with worldwide advertising customers to build systems that makes advertising and it's functions automated and frictionless? Then, Software Development team that builds Tier-1 Advertising Experience wants you!  
  
Amazon Advertising is looking for an entrepreneurial Software Development Engineer who shares Amazon Advertising’s passion for building and delivering a global, scaleable, extensible, and secure platform that singularly manages the Sourcing, Storage, Supply, Aggregation, Processing, Reporting of billions of clicks and impressions across multiple Advertising Billing, Budgeting, Financial and Payments services. You will build and ship software that directly impacts our end customer experience. You'll develop your team of highly motivated and talented multi-functional builders who can collaborate with product managers, technical specialists, and principals across the company. You will participate in defining the technology roadmap for our advertising billing strategy, and shape building technology tools that can disrupt the billing industry. You should be comfortable with a degree of ambiguity that’s higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving problems that, frankly, haven’t been solved at scale before - anywhere. You will encounter challenging, novel situations every day and given the size of this initiative, you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. We’re looking for entrepreneurs who are passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, can demonstrate a high degree of ownership, and want to have fun while they make history and craft beautiful products.  
  
A successful candidate will have strong technical skills, and a history of growing their talent, and ability go hands-on with their technologies to identify the real problems you're solving. Written and verbal communication in this role are critical: you will author narratives that will be consumed by Amazonians at all levels, including executive leadership.  
  
Key Technical Challenges:  
Distributed and Scalable Architecture: Looking at advertising international expansion and business growth plans for next year, we expect this traffic to grow 10X in near future. Billing and Budgeting system should be easily scalable to manage exponential increase in traffic and extensible to support different business needs.  
  
High Availability: Downtime of Billing and Budgeting system can cause a huge loss in revenue and loss of business opportunity for our advertisers. High Availability architecture is to make sure that the system is configured to handle different loads and different failures with minimal or no downtime.  
  
Precision: Every click or impression needs to be counted, accounted, invoiced, and charged in near real-time, without any exception. It impacts both revenue and regulatory compliance. We need to build generic and extensible reconcilers for any anomaly detection and raising an appropriate alarm.  
  
Tags: SDE, SDE-II, Software Development Engineer  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
Design, build and run distributed services for the Advertising Billing and Budgeting platform. These services source, store, aggregate and process billions of clicks and impressions, and they need to scale to 10X traffic growth as Amazon Advertising expands internationally.  
  
Own the high availability and operational health of Tier-1 billing systems. This means designing for failure tolerance and graceful degradation, keeping downtime close to zero, taking part in on-call, and driving root-cause fixes so the same issues don't come back.  
  
Work with product managers, principal engineers and partner teams in Amazon's Ads, Finance and Payments organizations to turn ambiguous business needs into clear technical designs. Write design docs and narratives for readers at every level, up to leadership.  
  
Raise the bar on operational and engineering excellence for systems that move billions of dollars. Find systemic risks before they turn into incidents, build mechanisms that make the platform self-healing and resilient, and set engineering standards that let the team move fast without giving up precision.  
  
Strengthen the team through thorough code and design reviews, mentoring junior engineers, and helping shape the technical roadmap for the advertising billing strategy.

* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

* Strong product thinking and systems intuition.
* Deep understanding of enterprise operations, supply chain workflows, or ERP systems.

* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs with long-term platform strategy.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to join the Finance Operations Risk, Governance and Experience (FORGE) team within Finance Operations (FinOps). This is a strategic, high ownership risk leadership role that strengthens Amazon's risk and control environment across complex, global Finance Operations processes.  
  
You will operate at the intersection of risk management, internal audit, controllership, process transformation, technology, and business operations. You will assess processes end to end, identify emerging and material risks, evaluate control effectiveness, and partner with stakeholders to design and implement sustainable solutions.  
  
This role is built for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The risks are not always obvious, ownership often spans multiple organizations, and the right answer frequently requires connecting data, processes, systems, policies, and controls across the company. You will not just identify problems. You will architect solutions, influence stakeholders, and drive measurable risk reduction.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Run end-to-end assessments that cover process design, policy, organization structure, systems, AI components, regulatory requirements, and internal controls.
* Evaluate whether controls are well designed and working, identify control gaps and policy exceptions, quantify their impact, and recommend proportionate mitigation.
* Assess risks from AI-enabled and agentic automations, including hallucination, model drift, prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agent permissions, bias, and loss of human oversight.
* Design and test AI-specific controls such as human-in-the-loop approval gates, output validation, least-privilege tool access, traceability, and model performance monitoring.
* Inspect AI solutions against Amazon security, privacy, and controllership requirements (such as security, privacy, SOX, ITGCs etc.,), and confirm that AI-driven steps have clear ownership, evidence, and auditability.
* Design, build, and maintain audit agents that continuously monitor process controls, test full transaction populations, and flag anomalies and control failures in near real time.
* Build and use AI capabilities across the audit lifecycle, and set validation and governance standards so that AI-generated findings are reliable, explainable, and defensible.
* Own cross-functional risk programs from problem definition through closure, defining success criteria and risk reduction metrics, including coverage and detection metrics for automated monitoring.
* Partner with Finance, Controllership, Technology, InfoSec, GFRC/SOX, and Internal Audit to drive remediation, support external audit requests, and influence leaders to adopt scalable, AI-enabled controls.

  
A day in the life  
You will start your morning reviewing overnight alerts from the audit agents that monitor SOX and operational controls, separating true exceptions from noise and escalating confirmed control failures to process owners. Much of your day involves moving between deep analysis and hands-on building. You might lead a pre-launch risk review of a new agentic automation, checking its data access, tool permissions, and human approval points before it goes live. Then you might work with Technology partners to tune an audit agent or extend it to cover a new control. Later, you could walk through a complex process with business owners, using generative AI to speed up documentation and testing, or challenge a remediation plan that fixes the symptom but not the root cause. You will also carve out time to write a concise narrative for senior leadership on emerging AI risks and inspection results, and to look for the next control that can move from periodic sampling to continuous monitoring, so FinOps assurance scales as fast as the business automates.  
  
About the team  
Our team is dedicated to building and scaling risk management programs that keep Amazon's customers and operations protected. We work at the intersection of business, technology, and compliance, partnering across the organization to identify emerging risks and implement practical solutions. We value curiosity, analytical rigor, and collaboration, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every team member can grow and contribute. If you want to shape how Amazon approaches risk at scale, this is the team for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience within financial services and payment institutions
* Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience at consulting firms or equivalent
* Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
* Master's degree or equivalent
* Experience working with or evaluating AI systems
* Experience assessing or auditing AI/ML or agentic systems using standards such as NIST and ISO

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
**Business Finance Lead**

PlatinumRx | Bangalore (On-site) | Full-time | Reports to: Head of Finance

**About PlatinumRx**

PlatinumRx is on a mission to make chronic medications affordable for every Indian household. Through a unique model built around high-quality generic substitution, we deliver meaningful savings to patients without compromising on care. We are Series A+ funded, growing at a rapid pace, and operate with industry-leading CAC and retention metrics among consumer health platforms in India.

We are scaling fast, which means every rupee matters. The person we hire will be the single point of ownership for how the company plans, tracks, and drives its financial outcomes, working closely with the founders and function heads to make sure growth is profitable, not just fast.

**About the Role**

This is a high-ownership role that exists to separate business finance from controllership. You will not be closing books or running audits. You will own the financial planning engine of the company: AOP, business partnering, investor reporting, and cost optimization. The primary OKR for this role is AOP attainment %, everything else ladders up to that one number.

You will report to the Head of Finance, work from our Bangalore office, and act as the financial nerve centre for every growth and profitability decision the company makes. A finance team of 2-3 CAs plus external consultants and analysts will report into this role, and all business-related financial decisions will be routed through you.

**What You Will Own**

***Planning and AOP***

* Own the Annual Operating Plan end to end: build it, get buy-in across functions, track attainment monthly, and course-correct when the business drifts from plan.
* Build and maintain the company’s financial model, revenue forecasts, and scenario analyses that the founders use for board and investor conversations.
* Own the monthly and quarterly business review decks with variance analysis, not just what happened but why, and what to do about it.

***Business Partnering***

* Act as the finance partner across growth, gross margin, capex, retention, and other key levers. When a function head wants to spend, expand, or hire, you are the person who pressure-tests the case and signs off on the numbers.
* Work with product, ops, sales, and category teams to build unit economics visibility at a granular level, by SKU, by warehouse, by channel, not just top-line.
* Drive cost optimization and lead negotiations across functions and vendors, with a clear link back to margin and AOP targets.

***Investor Reporting and Fundraising***

* Lead investor reporting: MIS, dashboards, and periodic updates that investors actually read and trust.
* Support fundraising diligence when the time comes: data room preparation, financial Q&A, and the analytical rigour that makes a Series B process smooth.

***Team Leadership***

* Manage a team of 2-3 CAs and external consultants/analysts. Set priorities, review work quality, and build a finance function that scales with the company.
* Build the reporting infrastructure (dashboards, templates, cadences) so that financial visibility is a system, not a monthly scramble.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5 to 7 years of progressive business finance experience in consumer internet, healthtech, e-commerce, or a similar high-growth environment.
* Strong track record in FP&A and business partnering, not just reporting. You should be able to point to decisions you influenced, not just decks you built.
* Comfortable owning a single, clear outcome metric (AOP attainment) and being measured on it, rather than broad, diffused ownership across accounting and compliance.
* Experience handling senior stakeholders: founders, CXOs, investors. You can present a financial story crisply and defend the assumptions behind it.
* Hands-on with financial modelling: Excel-native, comfortable building models from scratch, not dependent on templates.
* Experience managing a small finance team or analysts, even informally.
* CA, CFA, or MBA in Finance is a strong plus. What matters more is whether you think like a business owner, not just a finance person.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience at a Series A to C startup where you built the finance function or reporting infrastructure from scratch.
* Experience with investor reporting and fundraising diligence (Series A or B).
* Exposure to healthcare, pharmacy, or regulated industries where margin and compliance intersect.

**What Success Looks Like**

* First 30 days: You have mapped the full P&L, understood the AOP, identified the 2-3 biggest variance drivers, and built trust with every function head as someone who gets the business, not just the numbers.
* First 90 days: Monthly business reviews are running on your cadence, investor reporting is clean and on time, and you have flagged at least one cost optimization opportunity worth pursuing.
* First 6 months: AOP tracking is a system, not a fire drill. Function heads come to you before making financial decisions, not after. The finance team under you is running independently on the reporting rhythm you built.
